<style id="semicon-home-v2-css">/* Home only: retain Cocoon and every other page unchanged. */

<style id="scg-css">
.scg{max-width:1040px;margin:0 auto;padding:24px 16px 56px}
.scg h1{font-size:28px;margin:6px 0 10px}
